    "title": "Authentication decorator fails open when abort raises",
    "description": "require_auth catches every Exception, including the abort(401) it raises for missing or invalid credentials, and then calls the protected view anyway with g.user set to None.     "evidence": "The except block at lines 55-58 suppresses the authentication failure. GET /orders/1 with no Authorization header returned HTTP 200 and the complete order belonging to user 1. GET /giftcards/HFDEMO10 with no credentials also returned HTTP 200 and the card balance."

    "description": "The application protects admin routes by comparing request.path to the set of registered rule strings.
